summary: The candidate extends the existing self-defect job sanitizer so a supervisor matrix cell display name, matrix_cell followed by a 64 lowercase hex cell id, maps to the logical job matrix_cell instead of unknown-job. Tests cover valid ids, malformed ids and cross-cell deduplication of the filed issue, and the pattern matches both the supervisor workflow display name and the matrixCellIdV1 digest format.

evidence: ops/self-defects.ts lines 93-94 map only the exact matrix_cell plus 64 lowercase hex cell id display name to the logical job matrix_cell, so the supervisor cell failure filed as unknown-job now keys as sentinel-supervisor:matrix_cell:exit:1

tests/repair/self_defects_test.ts lines 114-146 assert the valid supervisor cell ids normalize to sentinel-supervisor:matrix_cell:exit:1 while malformed, uppercase, oversized and suffixed names stay unknown-job

tests/repair/hosted_self_observation_test.ts lines 334-384 assert the filed body carries job matrix_cell with no cell id or raw log text, and a failure in a second cell dedupes to self-observation:no_change

.github/workflows/supervisor.yml line 394 defines the matrix job name as matrix_cell plus matrix.cellId and src/contracts/matrix.ts lines 70-83 show matrixCellIdV1 returns a 64 lowercase hex digest, so the added pattern matches the real job name
